rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters answer a telegram requesting presidential consultation on racial or civil-rights issues, open with the distinctive formulation that the telegram “has had my thoughtful attention/consideration,” then discuss constitutional progress through moderation, understanding, and responsible action by officials at different levels of government before resolving the request. C12 closely parallels the narrower request-and-meeting function, while C07 shares the immediate civil-rights context and response-to-telegram form, but neither matches as much of the child’s language and argumentative structure as C23.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your telegram requesting a meeting with me has had my thoughtful consideration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your telegram of March twenty-second, in which you suggest that a conference of Southern Governors and Attorneys General be called by me ... has had my thoughtful attention.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim opening describing thoughtful consideration of a telegram seeking a presidential meeting or conference.

shared_material.child_excerpt: progress must steadily be made in assuring to all citizens equality under our Constitution and under the laws
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the progress already made in certain regions of the South ... is a clear indication that we can look forward to even greater progress
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the response around continued progress in racial relations following federal constitutional developments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: citizens will more readily respond ... if explanation, understanding and moderation as well as firmness of purpose are used by officials of government at every level
shared_material.parent_excerpt: we can look forward to even greater progress if we can look to moderate and responsible leadership supported by a spirit of patience ... responsibilities that lie primarily with State and local governments, as indeed the responsibilities of the Federal government
shared_material.explanation: Parallel reliance on moderation, understanding or patience, responsible leadership, and coordinated responsibilities across levels of government.
